intro: A Fine Moonstalker Pelt is the thick, pristine hide taken from the most mature predatory moonstalkers roaming southern Darkshore. Terenthis of Auberdine uses these prized furs to weave an enchanted cloak that allows searchers to slip past the woods' hostile beasts unnoticed.

p: While common moonstalkers prowl throughout the mist-laden forests of Darkshore, only the older moonstalker sires and matriarchs possess coats dense and healthy enough to yield a fine pelt. These powerful wildcats establish territories along the Wildbend River and further south toward the borders of Ashenvale, where they hunt with lethal patience.
